definitions.explanation: Emphasizes that something is absolutely impossible or cannot be achieved under any circumstances. It requires a negative predicate: the adverb signals the denial in advance and cannot stand in an affirmative sentence.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{到底|とうてい}⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食|た}べきれない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: There's no way I can eat this amount by myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{到底|とうてい}⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: His actions are utterly beyond my comprehension.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{到底|とうてい}⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: There's no way we'll make it by the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{到底|とうてい}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いけない→いく：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: On my current salary there is simply no way to make ends meet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{習得|しゅうとく}→習得：13903_shuutoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{到底|とうてい}⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ。
examples.english: Mastering Japanese completely in one year is simply out of the question.

notes:
USAGE:
{到底|とうてい} + NEGATIVE predicate.

This adverb is a polarity item: it needs a negative to complete it. It sets up the negation early in the sentence, so a Japanese listener knows from {到底|とうてい} alone that a denial is coming. A positive {到底|とうてい}⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ is ungrammatical, not merely unusual.
The speaker is not reporting a difficulty but closing off a possibility — "however you look at it, it cannot be done". It carries a resigned, slightly formal tone and is common in writing and in careful speech.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {到底|とうてい}〜⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (absolutely cannot ~)
- {到底|とうてい}〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (there is no way ~)
- {到底|とうてい}⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ (utterly impossible)
- {到底|とうてい}⟦{信|しん}じられない→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧ (cannot possibly believe)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - cannot possibly ~; the same structure, more conversational and slightly less emphatic
- ⟦{絶対|ぜったい}に→絶対に：08722_zettaini⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - absolutely will not ~; about certainty or refusal, and it works with positives too
- ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - cannot ~ however hard one tries; stresses the effort expended, not the impossibility itself
